name: Countless Cubes Chicagoland B 2024

venue.name: County Line Orchard
venue.address: 200 S County Line Rd, Hobart, IN 46342

information:
All speedsolving events will be held at this competition! Because this is not a typical competition, all competitors must read the [Competition Format](#26676-competition-format) tab. Competitors interested in blindfolded events should consider registering for the other competition in this series: [Countless Cubes Chicagoland A](CountlessCubesChicagoA2024).

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
